simple.meaning: לוּחַ (lûwach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “probably meaning to glisten ; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 43 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Proverbs, and 5 more, beginning at Exodus 24:12. Its contexts include covenant, Torah, kingship, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּחַ (H3871).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לוּחַ (lûwach) / H3871 is traced through Exodus 24:12, Exodus 27:8, Exodus 31:18, Exodus 32:15 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H3871. luach לוּחַ noun masculine tablet, board or plank, plate (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic לוּחָא , ; Arabic ; (modern pronunciation lûµ, lôµ , compare e.g. Spiro Arab.-Eng. Vocab. Buhl), Ethiopic , but Assyrian li±û (as if from לחה ) in Dl HWB 366 ; see, however, lêjum (lêyum) Jäger BAS i, 486 ); — ׳ל absolute Isa 30:8 ; construct Prov 3:3-4 t.; dual לֻחֹתָ֑יִם Ezek 27:5 ; plural לוחֹת ( לֻחֹת לֻחוֺת, ) absolute Exod 32:16-17 t.; construct Deut 4:13 16 t.; — 1 chiefly of stone tablets on which ten words were written Exod 24:12 ; 31:18 b; 32:16 (twice in verse); 32:19 (all E), 34:1 (3 t. in verse); 34:4 (twice in verse); 34:28 (all J), Deut 4:13 ; 5:19 ; 9:9-10 , 11 , 17 ; 10:1-2 ,(twice in verse); 10:3 (twice in verse); 10:4-5 , 1Kin 8:9 ; 2Chr 5:10 ; ׳ל הָעֵדֻת Exod 31:18 a; 32:15 ; compare 34:29 (all P); ׳ל הַבְּרִית Deut 9:9 , 11 , 15 ; tablet for writing prophecy Isa 30:8 ׅ || (סֵפֶר , Hab 2:2 , and figurative, b> לָבְּךָ לוּחַ Prov 3:3 ; 7:3 (for writing wise counsel), compare Jer 17:1 (inscribing sin of Judah); (verb mostly כָּחַב Exod 31:18 b; 32:15 ; Deut 9:10 ; ׳כ עַל Exod 34:1 , 28 ; Deut 4:13 ; 5:19 ; 10:2 , 4 ; Prov 3:3 ; 7:3 ; Isa 30:8 ; עַל חָרַשׁ Jer 17:1 ; כָּרַת followed by accusative Deut 9:9 compare 1Kin 8:9 2Chr 5:10 ; עַל חָרַת Exod 32:16 ; עַל בֵּאֵר Hab 2:2 ). 2 wooden boards , composing altar of tabernacle Exod 27:8 ; 38:7 ; planks composing ship (figurative of Tyre) Ezek 27:5 ; cf, אָ֑רֶז לוּחַ עָלָיהָ נָצוּר Song 8:9 , of door. 3 (metal) plates on bases of lavers in Solomon's temple 1Kin 7:36 .
